selected_problem: Fresh canonical-main inspection found that AutonomousMissionStore.addEvidence generated a mission evidence id and timestamp, then spread caller evidence afterward. Caller-supplied id/at could therefore overwrite the store-owned receipt identity and time while the mission event ledger trusted the resulting evidenceId.（最新规范主仓检查发现 AutonomousMissionStore.addEvidence 先生成使命证据 ID 与时间戳，随后才展开调用方证据，导致调用方自带 id/at 可以覆盖存储拥有的回执身份与时间，而使命事件账本又会信任被覆盖后的 evidenceId。）

decision_provenance.route_basis: The defect is a singular, directly falsifiable ledger-identity invariant already established for the sibling RunStore evidence boundary. Closing it requires no new product shape, trust architecture, or forced mode rotation, so source-contract replay narrows to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT.（该缺陷是单一、可直接反证的账本身份不变量，且同级 RunStore 证据边界已经确立相同约束；闭合它不需要选择新产品形态、信任架构或强制轮换模式，因此源码契约重放收敛到深度开发模式。）

verification.focused_reality_replay: 2/2 PASS; forged id/at no longer win and ordinary evidence payload remains intact（2/2 通过；伪造 id/at 不再覆盖，普通证据负载保持不变）

truth_boundary: This protects only the store-generated identity and timestamp of newly appended Autonomous Mission evidence receipts. It does not authenticate already persisted mission evidence or introduce an external trust root.（本轮只保护新追加自治使命证据回执由存储生成的身份与时间戳；不认证已经持久化的使命证据，也不引入外部信任根。）
